title: minify index.hash.js for loading time improvement
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

Just discovered StreamLit and love it already! 

I built a minimal chatbot and started to examine the way it works and noticed the size of _index._hash_.js_ is around 1.8Mb. Looking at it I see it's uncompressed JS that might be optimised.

I was wondering if this file can be **minified** in the local compilation pipeline in order to improve loading time: useful for production deployments or set via a config option.

Sorry if I totally misunderstand the way it works; I also didn't find any issue or question related to minification. 

### Why?

I expect the production build to be minified when I look in DevTools/Network, it will improve loading time.

### How?

Include a last step in the generation of the index.js file that will minify the newly generated index.js file

### Additional Context

_No response_
